note: Private 26-acre campground at 5005 Long Rapids Rd with frontage on the Thunder Bay River and Lake Wynah; full-hookup and electric-water RV sites (some waterfront, some lakefront) plus rustic sites, canoe/kayak livery and boat launch. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's own 2026 rate page: electric-water $37 to full-hookup waterfront $44, water and sewer hookups, pull-throughs, reservable on RezExpert; phone 989-356-3708 matches. Changed fees low 29 -> 37 (the $29 is a rustic site); added season May 1 - Oct 15, 3-night holiday minimum, booking platform/url, restrooms/dump/store. Note cleaned of season, booking and rating text the fields hold. Not stated by the operator: amperage, site count/98 and 50-ft max (left as derived), military discount (left as from the Good Sam directory). Seasonal rates are posted for some site types but the seasonal share is not stated; nightly sites are sold online, so it is not seasonal in character on the evidence. Price gate passes ($37; the 3% card surcharge makes it ~$38).
